title: Action by attorney general.
bodyText: The attorney general may maintain an action to restrain a foreign limited liability company from transacting business in this State in violation of this part.
bodyHtml: [§428-1009]  Action by attorney general.  The attorney general may maintain an action to restrain a foreign limited liability company from transacting business in this State in violation of this part. [L 1996, c 92, pt of §1]
